exposure: Celiac disease diagnosis status (diagnosed vs. undiagnosed before delivery)
cohort: Singleton pregnancies in England between 1997 and 2012 resulting in a live birth or stillbirth
finding: Celiac disease, whether diagnosed or undiagnosed during pregnancy, is not associated with a major increased risk of pregnancy complications and adverse birth outcomes.
mod_finding: Women with diagnosed CD had a slightly higher risk of postpartum hemorrhage and assisted delivery.
